title: Counter-Selector Wave 34: executable bounded-package handoff control
purpose: Demonstrate that the handoff gate can clear when a versioned package, exact authority and dependency ledgers, explicit open-decision and rollback state, package-level recipient acknowledgment, safe decline, fresh-workspace successor operation, and separate verification all join on one bounded object.

complete_bounded_package_requires: one identified package with exact entry hashes and combined digest
bounded outgoing and incoming authority with prohibited actions
explicit credential and access inventory including an explicit empty set
complete runtime, tool, repository, network, and external-service dependency inventory
explicit open-decision inventory including an explicit empty set
decline conditions and rollback state that prevent partial publication
recipient acknowledgment of the exact identified package and entries
successor operation in a fresh workspace using the package as the sole state bridge
separate verification of the successor object and acknowledgment

source_records.title: Wave 33 public handoff package truth table
source_records.artifact_scope: Defines the difference between labels, templates, partial packages, source-restricted packages, recipient acknowledgment, and complete direct handoff.

source_records.title: Storing and sharing data from a workflow
source_records.artifact_scope: Documents upload and download of workflow artifacts used as the bounded package transport between separate jobs.

source_records.title: Workflow syntax for GitHub Actions
source_records.artifact_scope: Documents job dependencies, permissions, and fresh runner execution surfaces used to separate outgoing, recipient, and verifier roles.

source_records.title: Node.js Crypto API
source_records.artifact_scope: Documents the SHA-256 primitive used to bind package entries, package manifests, successor objects, and acknowledgments.

counterevidence: The object and transition are deliberately small and deterministic.
The outgoing, recipient, and verifier are process roles inside one repository and one workflow institution.
No unfamiliar problem, real secret custody, live external service, interpersonal repair, or cross-domain transfer is tested.
A fresh runner job is process separation, not an independent human or institution.
The package proves a bounded handoff contract, not a person-level operator phenotype.
falsifiers: the recipient can complete after an entry hash mismatch
the recipient requires repository checkout or hidden external state
the recipient emits output before package validation finishes
the acknowledgment does not bind the exact package manifest
the successor object differs from the canonical transition contract
the verifier accepts a modified successor object or acknowledgment

next_action: Apply the now-proven package contract to real candidate and public control surfaces; require one identified outgoing package, package-level recipient acknowledgment, authority and credential ledger, dependency and open-decision inventory, rollback conditions, successor operation without hidden predecessor state, and genuinely independent review before any person-level custody upgrade.
